items.title: Cedar Walton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

ctx.x: Uh, yes, but not that anxiously. I like the small group concept, context. I'm more comfortable with that. But uh, John Faddis was uh good enough to invite me out to uh the Chicago School of Music where he uh presides and has an orchestra, and what we did was … Dear Ruth was the only one I orchestrated. But uh Frank Foster had a marvelous uh orchestration of uh Firm Roots that uh we borrowed, we were able to rent them from, you know, and Rufus Reid had about three uh we used, and uh, it seems like there was…
